blocks.text: Introduction to Match Case
Python 3.10 introduced the match case statement, which allows for more expressive and concise conditional logic.
The match case statement is used for structural pattern matching.

blocks.code:
def http_status(status_code):
    match status_code:
        case 200:
            return "OK"
        case 400:
            return "Bad Request"
        case 404:
            return "Not Found"
        case _:
            return "Something went wrong"
